items.text: Add a reusable "Need verify in browser" function/capability to ACEsi for future use.
Bring back the real-time log in ACEsi's terminal, including all emojis that were previously shown.
Add amber-themed confirmation pop-ups for the Code Editor toolbar actions: Save, Format, Clear, Copy, and Paste. Do not use the standard browser theme.
Add the search button back to the Code Editor so words can be searched inside the editor.
Add Ctrl+G back to the Code Editor toolbar for line-number search/go-to-line.
